items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: He was with me a good while.

ctx.x: He was with me a good while.

Al was pretty nice and when he left the band he got on the Playboy circuit as a singer; he was nice, he was all right. They found Al and Al said I'll have to give notice where I'm working, and he met me in Vernal, Utah. First we were saying Salt Lake City and he couldn't, but Burns had us in a number of towns in Utah, and he could find them, I don't know how he would do it, and so we were there and Al got there before we did and so he went in--he was just so nervous when we got in town, they jumped him, are you…
